name: Girls & sweets
source:
Ten years have passed since Aika left Japan, she had to part with her beloved sister. All the time that she lived in New York she could not find her happiness. And now it's time to come back, unpleasant circumstances require it: the death of a grandfather.

When she returns, she learns that her sister, Yuno, has already been married for a long time and lives a quiet measured life.

But feelings for her sister have not yet died away, will they be able to settle old differences and be together again? Or will Ike have to go back to New York and forever regret the lost chance?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/993750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
爱香离开日本已经十年，与心爱的妹妹分别。生活在纽约期间，她始终找不到幸福。如今，祖父去世这一令人不快的情况迫使她回国。

回来后，她得知妹妹由乃早已结婚，过着平静规律的生活。

然而，对妹妹的感情仍未消失。她们能化解旧日分歧、再次相守吗？还是爱香必须回到纽约，永远后悔错失的机会？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/993750/]Steam[/url]]
